official_sources.title: gdal raster clip window semantics
official_sources.finding: --window is column,line,width,height; bbox clipping expands to whole input pixel boundaries without resampling and outside-source behavior is explicit.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterIOExtraArg floating window
official_sources.finding: Floating-point source windows use dfXOff/dfYOff/dfXSize/dfYSize with explicit validity and bounded relation to integer window fields.

official_sources.title: gdal_translate source-window semantics
official_sources.finding: -srcwin uses xoff,yoff,xsize,ysize; partially outside behavior can fill with zero/nodata or fail with -epo/-eco; -projwin selection semantics changed in GDAL 3.11.

official_sources.title: GDAL VRT SrcRect and DstRect
official_sources.finding: VRT SrcRect/DstRect are explicit pixel/line rectangles and differing source/destination sizes imply mapped/resampled derived values rather than native one-to-one cell identity.

official_sources.title: GDAL RFC51 floating source windows
official_sources.finding: RasterIO extra arguments distinguish precise floating source windows from integer xoff/yoff/xsize/ysize, making rounding policy a replay dependency.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pipeline clip contract
official_sources.finding: Pipeline clip exposes bbox/window/geometry/like as distinct mutually exclusive window-definition modes and preserves their explicit parameters.

official_sources.title: gdal raster as-features row-column QA
official_sources.finding: Pixel features can include ROW/COL and center X/Y, providing an independent QA channel for exact selected-window cell identities.

official_sources.title: gdalbuildvrt source priority and grid derivation
official_sources.finding: VRT mosaics can derive resolution/alignment and overlapping-source priority from options/input order, so derived mosaic windows are not native source-window proof.

official_sources.title: NumPy take out-of-bounds modes
official_sources.finding: take defaults to mode=raise; wrap and clip deliberately remap out-of-bounds indices and are unsuitable for fail-closed terminal raster addressing.

official_sources.title: GDALDataset RasterIO window contract
official_sources.finding: RasterIO defines nXOff/nYOff as top-left offsets and nXSize/nYSize as width/height; different buffer size triggers decimation/replication.

official_sources.title: GDAL Python ReadAsArray window contract
official_sources.finding: ReadAsArray exposes xoff/yoff/xsize/ysize and separately buf_xsize/buf_ysize; mismatches invoke the selected resampling algorithm.

official_sources.title: NumPy choose bounds modes
official_sources.finding: choose defines raise/wrap/clip out-of-range handling; terminal index logic should fail rather than silently wrap or clamp.

official_sources.title: NumPy clip value clamping
official_sources.finding: clip replaces values outside a range by edge values; using it on raster row/column addresses would hide out-of-bounds errors.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBand actual edge block size
official_sources.finding: GetActualBlockSize reports true valid dimensions for partial right/bottom edge blocks, preventing padded block cells from entering selected windows.

official_sources.title: GDALRasterBlock offsets
official_sources.finding: Raster blocks expose top-left block offsets and block dimensions, which must be reconciled to global row/column window coordinates.

official_sources.title: NumPy indexing and slicing
official_sources.finding: Indices are zero-based with valid range 0<=i<dimension and basic slices select indices strictly less than stop, matching half-open window semantics.

official_sources.title: NumPy slice-object construction
official_sources.finding: np.s_ materializes normal slice objects, enabling exact row_start:row_stop and col_start:col_stop manifests instead of ad-hoc inclusive bounds.

official_sources.title: gdal raster pixel-info location QA
official_sources.finding: pixel-info reports input coordinates converted to column/line plus pixel values and VRT contributing sources, useful as independent source-window QA.

official_sources.title: gdal raster compare golden raster
official_sources.finding: Golden comparison checks width, height, datatype, nodata, pixels and optional geotransform/metadata, supporting exact extracted-window replay.

official_sources.title: gdal raster stack extent and resolution
official_sources.finding: Stack can derive bbox, resolution and target alignment; same-resolution mode can fail on mismatched source grids, emphasizing grid/window provenance.

official_sources.title: gdalcompare legacy golden comparison
official_sources.finding: Legacy golden comparison reports pixel, geotransform, SRS and metadata differences, providing another independent subset replay channel.

official_sources.title: gdal raster mosaic grid derivation
official_sources.finding: Mosaic output resolution and target-aligned extent can be derived from inputs, so mosaic subset indices cannot be assumed identical to native source indices.

official_sources.title: NumPy ravel_multi_index bounds policy
official_sources.finding: ravel_multi_index defaults to mode=raise while wrap/clip alter invalid indices; order=C/F also changes flat cell identity.

official_sources.title: gdal raster reproject chunk/source regions
official_sources.finding: Reprojection derives output chunks and contributing rectangular source regions, which are derived processing windows and not native terminal sampling windows.

official_sources.title: gdal raster info exact raster dimensions
official_sources.finding: Raster info reports exact width/height, origin, pixel size, axis mapping and corner coordinates needed to validate window bounds before reads.

official_sources.title: gdal_rasterize extent and size semantics
official_sources.finding: Rasterize separately controls target extent, resolution, size and target alignment; changing any creates a different output grid and membership window.
